prompt.zh-TW: 海風民宿的應收款項週轉率是 {{number:vars.turnover|digits=2,unit=times}}。要算出平均收現日數，應該怎麼做？
prompt.en: Sea Breeze Guesthouse has a receivables turnover of {{number:vars.turnover|digits=2,unit=times}}. How do you work out the average collection period?

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。一年轉幾輪，每一輪就是一年除以輪數那麼多天。
feedback.en: That’s right. If receivables turn over a certain number of times a year, each turn lasts the days in a year divided by that number.

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道天數和週轉率有關，也用到了一年的天數，方向對了一半。不過週轉率越高表示收款越快、天數應該越短，所以是用一年的天數去「除以」週轉率，不是相乘。
feedback.en: You know days and turnover are linked and used the days in a year, so you are halfway there. But higher turnover means faster collection and fewer days, so you divide the days in a year by the turnover rather than multiplying.

text.zh-TW: 用營業收入除以週轉率

feedback.zh-TW: 營業收入除以週轉率算回來的是應收帳款的餘額，單位是金額，不是天數。
feedback.en: Revenue divided by turnover gives you back the receivables balance, an amount of money rather than a number of days.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_gysqtps0}}＝一年的天數 ÷ {{term:tm_2s4hterv}}。{{option:o_yafp}}是正確的換算；{{option:o_4awy}}會得到一個越收越快、天數卻越多的矛盾結果，{{option:o_7fjm}}算出來的是金額。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_gysqtps0}} = days in a year ÷ {{term:tm_2s4hterv}}. {{option:o_yafp}} is the right conversion; {{option:o_4awy}} would absurdly give more days the faster the collection, and {{option:o_7fjm}} produces an amount of money.
